_comment: The skin packs sold in the Shop (Esc menu; scripts/ui/skin_shop.gd) for Sand Dollars, the in-game currency bought with Steam money (scripts/autoload/cosmetics.gd): one Sand Dollar is one cent. A pack: its ships' skins (model id -> art/skins/<folder>/<name>.svg, drawn in place of the model's art, untinted), the CEO and captain outfit options it unlocks (names in Characters.PARTS: tops, bottoms, shoes, headwear; drawn by Portrait), the crew hats (headwear names, in the deck atlas) and uniform colours it adds (CrewLooks). Bundles: the Sand Dollar bundles on the Sand Dollars page, each a Steam Inventory item definition (steam_itemdef: set up on the Steamworks partner site with its price; usd here is what's shown).

packs.title: 2026 Thanksgiving Pack
packs.blurb: The whole table, afloat: a roast turkey, corn on the cob, candied yams, green bean casserole, cranberry sauce, stuffing, a gravy boat, drumsticks, dinner rolls, pumpkin pie, mashed potatoes, a cornucopia and the Mayflower. Pilgrim, colonial and 1620 deckhand outfits for your CEO and captains, and the crew in capotains, coifs, Monmouth caps or a turkey hat.

packs.title: 2026 Baseball Pack
packs.blurb: Ballpark fare for the fleet: five hot dogs from the mini dog to the foot-long with everything, bats in ash, black and royal blue, peanuts, popcorn, a soda cup, a softball, two baseballs, a pretzel, a catcher's mitt, a batting helmet, home plate, a baseball, a giant foam finger, a scoreboard and cotton candy. Home pinstripes, road greys, catcher's gear, an umpire, a hot dog vendor and 1920s flannels for your CEO and captains; ball caps, helmets and masks for the crew.
